Downstream reporting that treats '0.0% false completion' as overall 100% success misrepresents generalization. summarize_case_outcomes/assert_pass_rate_not_fabricated now reject that collapse.

FormalAcceptanceOracle RESOURCE_CLEANUP treats missing resource_delta as orphans==0. verify_f0_24a_evidence_closure accepts stage_verdict PASS_CLEAN without checking process_cleaned_up. F0_24A_RESOURCE_RESIDUE.json literally pairs process_cleaned_up=false with verdict=PASS_CLEAN.

GoalVerifier.evaluate returns GOAL_COMPLETED when contract is None. validate_plan success is independent of physical execution; any harness that counts validation_passed as success treats planning as execution.
